stories.title: Exclusive | As Xi’s US visit approaches, basic details of planned AI talks remain uncertain
stories.simple_summary: US and Chinese leaders are planning to discuss AI, but the details of what they'll talk about aren't clear yet.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and policy watchers — nothing you need to act on right now.

stories.title: Relativity Networks raises $22 million to bring a faster kind of fiber to data centers
stories.simple_summary: A company developed a new type of internet cable that moves data 30% faster than regular cables and raised money to use it in data centers (the buildings that store and process information for companies).
stories.why_it_matters: This might make internet services slightly faster someday, but it's mainly interesting to tech companies and investors, not small business owners.

stories.title: China’s backflipping robots leap to blockbuster stock market debut in latest sign of AI boom
stories.simple_summary: A Chinese company that makes robots just had a very successful first day of selling stock on the stock market, partly because AI is getting a lot of attention right now.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — it shows people are excited about AI businesses, but it won't directly affect your daily life.

stories.title: Bridgewater’s top investors are backing an AI startup to give smaller hedge funds more firepower
stories.simple_summary: Big investment managers are funding a new AI company to help smaller hedge funds (investment groups) compete better.
stories.why_it_matters: This is for wealthy investors only — nothing relevant to ordinary small business owners.

stories.title: The Rise and Fall of the Artificial State by Jill Lepore review – an ominous warning of tech takeover
stories.simple_summary: A book review warns that technology companies are getting too much power over our society.
stories.why_it_matters: This is someone's opinion about big tech trends — worth thinking about, but no immediate action needed.

stories.title: China urges respect for digital sovereignty in AI race
stories.simple_summary: China is saying that countries should have the right to control their own digital technology and AI systems.
stories.why_it_matters: This is government-level politics — nothing you need to act on as a small business owner.

stories.title: Young Americans really hate AI. These two charts show how much.
stories.simple_summary: Young Americans say they don't like or trust AI, according to recent surveys.
stories.why_it_matters: This tells us what people think, but doesn't change anything concrete — it's mostly interesting to researchers and marketers.

stories.title: Artificial intelligence acts as an 'ideological chameleon' and may deepen political polarization
stories.simple_summary: AI can pretend to be any political side and might make people's disagreements worse because it tells each group what they want to hear.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a real concern worth knowing about — be cautious when AI or social media shows you only one viewpoint.

stories.title: Broadcom vs. Nvidia: 1 Metric Shows Which Artificial Intelligence (AI) Chipmaker Is the Better Bargain
stories.simple_summary: An article compares the stock prices of two companies that make computer chips for AI, trying to figure out which is a better investment.
stories.why_it_matters: This is for stock investors only — nothing you need to know.

stories.title: Cursor capitalizes on GitHub frustration, launches rival hosting platform
stories.simple_summary: A company that makes AI writing tools is starting a new service to host computer code, competing with a popular website called GitHub.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly interesting to software developers — it won't affect most small business owners.

stories.title: Robin Williams’ Instagram account brought back to fight ‘AI abuse’
stories.simple_summary: Robin Williams' children took over his Instagram account because AI was being used to create fake videos of him, and they want to prevent that abuse.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows a real problem: AI can copy someone's face or voice without permission, which is why you should be careful about who you give your photos and videos to.

stories.title: OpenAI lays out new security changes after its AI hacked Hugging Face
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI (a major AI company) is adding better security protections after one of their AI systems accidentally broke into another company's computer system.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows AI is powerful enough to be risky, so companies need to be careful — good to know that they're taking security seriously.
